column1: # Each control requires its own physical execution ID, independently
# derived adverse material, a reason-specific detector, a full
# a restored-byte digest and an absence-of-vacuity assertion. A control
# that simply edits the word PASS is not an experiment.
# The detector is the compiled PolyC verifier
# modes are listed below. The detector RECOMPUTES the fact it checks.

CSET adapter counted as independent semantic authority
`IR_CMP_EQ` zero treated as failure or wrong suffix
Unsupported/invalid comparison falls back to arbitrary suffix
Borrowed string not NUL-terminated or mutated/freed by host
Target ABI C declaration and Mach-O symbol/relocation mismatch
G0 selector-OFF object imports either new A64 PolyC export
G0 legacy C tables removed or dormant when selector OFF
PolyC subject missing effective prerequisite or produced by wrong compiler

Reused producer digest, swapped producer identity or same stream paired with itself
PAIR12 substituted for FROZEN12 obligations or missing member
